env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/property_promoted.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/property_promoted.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/property_promoted.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd x
logos run .
stdout '^16 16$'
stdout '^1 orc orc$'
cp stdout $WORK/x-native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/p/p.go
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/x-native.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd c
logos build ./...
logos eject -o out
exists out/m/main.go
exists out/p/p.go
! grep -E 'Logos_Get|Logos_Set' out/m/main.go
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run ./m
stdout '^3$'
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..
cd cfail
! logos build ./...
stderr 'correctness::property_requires_conformance'
cd ..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/propertypromoted

go 1.27

-- c/go.mod --
module example.com/promotedc

go 1.27

-- c/p/p.lgo --
package p

type Slot interface {
	P int
}

type Impl struct : Slot {
	P int
}

-- c/m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/promotedc/p"
)

type Outer struct {
	*p.Impl
}

func main() {
	o := &Outer{Impl: &p.Impl{P: 1}}
	o.P = 2
	q := &o.P
	*q++
	fmt.Println(o.P)
}

-- cfail/go.mod --
module example.com/promotedcfail

go 1.27

-- cfail/p/p.lgo --
package p

type Slot interface {
	P int
}

type Impl struct : Slot {
	P int
}

-- cfail/m/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/promotedcfail/p"

type Outer struct {
	*p.Impl
}

var _ p.Slot = &Outer{}

func main() {
	o := &Outer{Impl: &p.Impl{P: 1}}
	o.P = 2
	println(o.P)
}

-- x/go.mod --
module example.com/promotedx

go 1.27

-- x/p/p.lgo --
package p

type Slot interface {
	P int
}

type Title interface {
	const Name string
}

type Impl struct : Slot {
	P int
}

type Named struct : Title {
	Name string
}

-- x/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/promotedx/p"
)

type Box struct {
	p.Slot
}

type Label struct {
	p.Title
}

type Sub struct : p.Slot {
	p.Slot
}

func main() {
	im := &p.Impl{P: 4}
	b := &Box{Slot: im}
	b.P += 3
	b.P++
	var s p.Slot = b
	s.P *= 2
	fmt.Println(im.P, b.P)
	sub := &Sub{Slot: im}
	var d p.Slot = sub
	d.P = 1
	l := Label{Title: p.Named{Name: "orc"}}
	var t p.Title = l
	fmt.Println(im.P, l.Name, t.Name)
}
